purpose: Instantiate one candidate projection from the Core Expression into an already-governed RT expression without modifying RT_core.

source_artifacts.used_for: explicit rebinding and RT closure witness

non_claims: Does not assert all RTs are projections.
Does not identify the Core Expression with RT_core.

ordered_projection.step_1: Declare the Core Expression as a provisional generative label distinct from RT_core.
ordered_projection.step_2: Declare the receiving domain as projection_regime_xb.
ordered_projection.step_3: Type the projection as pi(projection_regime_xb, tau, Adm_projection_048).
ordered_projection.step_4: Apply the projection to the Core Expression to obtain a candidate projected expression.
ordered_projection.step_5: Verify RT closure for the projected expression under the governing RT condition.
ordered_projection.step_6: Compare the projected expression against the existing governed RT witness A_x(BasinClosureRT_B0).

candidate_projection.reading: The projection is a witness candidate only after explicit domain typing and RT closure verification. The comparison target remains an already-governed RT expression.

rt_closure_verification.condition: The projected expression is treated as a projected RT candidate only if it closes under the governing RT condition.
rt_closure_verification.result_reading: Closure in this witness supports representability, not universal projection or identity.

comparison.reading: The example compares a Core Expression projection to a previously governed RT witness without collapsing the two objects.

supported_reading.statement: This example supports one governed projection witness from the Core Expression into an existing RT expression while leaving RT_core unchanged.

non_claims: Does not promote the Core Expression into RT_core.
Does not assert that all RTs are projections.
Does not assert uniqueness or invertibility.
Does not erase the distinction between the Core Expression and the governed RT witness.
